subject.title: Feature: force media delivery as document attachment (e.g. #doc)

question: Should OpenClaw add force-document behavior beyond the current per-call `forceDocument`/`asDocument` knobs, and should that contract be `MEDIA:#doc`, a channel-level default, or no broader contract for now?
rationale: Current main and the latest release solve explicit per-call sends, while the remaining request creates either new model-facing syntax or new channel config/default behavior that repository policy treats as compatibility-sensitive.

options.title: Keep per-call canonical
options.body: Keep `--force-document` and `asDocument` as the supported contract for now and require a sponsored narrower proposal before adding syntax or config defaults.

options.title: Add `MEDIA:#doc` syntax
options.body: Define fragment parsing and media-kind semantics in the shared media pipeline, then thread it through affected delivery paths with tests and live proof.

options.title: Add a channel default
options.body: Design a default-off per-channel or per-account setting with explicit per-call override semantics, upgrade docs, and proof that existing default behavior remains intact.

recommendation.title: Keep per-call canonical
recommendation.body: Keep `--force-document` and `asDocument` as the supported contract for now and require a sponsored narrower proposal before adding syntax or config defaults.

likelyOwner.reason: mcaxtr merged the WhatsApp forced-document path and is the strongest maintainer-side routing signal among the related current behavior history.
